metadata.principle: The Atmakaraka's position in the Navamsha (D-9) chart is called the Karakamsha Lagna. It reveals soul-level karma — what the soul seeks, what it brings from past lives, and why it incarnated.
metadata.atmakaraka_definition: The planet with the highest degree in its sign (excluding Rahu and Ketu). This planet represents the soul's deepest desires and karmic agenda.
metadata.importance: Karakamsha is the second most important lagna after the natal ascendant. Where the natal lagna shows outer destiny, KL shows inner soul purpose.

atmakaraka_planets.sun: Soul seeks authority, recognition, and service to the divine principle. The ego must be transcended through service.
atmakaraka_planets.moon: Soul seeks emotional connection, nurturing, and public life. Must learn to give without attachment.
atmakaraka_planets.mars: Soul seeks action, courage, and conquest. Must channel energy from aggression to dharmic action.
atmakaraka_planets.mercury: Soul seeks knowledge, communication, and trade. Must evolve from cleverness to wisdom.
atmakaraka_planets.jupiter: Highest natural Atmakaraka. Soul seeks wisdom, teaching, and dharmic expansion. Born to guide others.
atmakaraka_planets.venus: Soul seeks beauty, love, and harmony. Must evolve from sensual enjoyment to devotional love.
atmakaraka_planets.saturn: Soul seeks to complete karma through discipline, service, and patience. Heavy karmic load but great potential for liberation.
atmakaraka_planets.rahu: Indicates unusual soul journey — foreign influences, unconventional paths, obsessive seeking. Soul needs to face and transcend its obsessions.

karakamsha_lagna_signs.aries: KL in Aries — soul is pioneering, courageous, action-oriented. Karmic theme: leadership and initiative.
karakamsha_lagna_signs.taurus: KL in Taurus — soul seeks stability, beauty, and material harmony. Karmic theme: wealth and sense gratification to be transcended.
karakamsha_lagna_signs.gemini: KL in Gemini — soul seeks knowledge, communication, duality. Karmic theme: integration of opposites.
karakamsha_lagna_signs.cancer: KL in Cancer — soul seeks emotional security, home, and public connection. Karmic theme: nourishing others.
karakamsha_lagna_signs.leo: KL in Leo — soul seeks recognition, creativity, and self-expression. Karmic theme: ego vs. soul expression.
karakamsha_lagna_signs.virgo: KL in Virgo — soul seeks service, analysis, and practical skills. Karmic theme: discrimination and purification.
karakamsha_lagna_signs.libra: KL in Libra — soul seeks balance, partnership, and justice. Karmic theme: harmony through relationship.
karakamsha_lagna_signs.scorpio: KL in Scorpio — soul seeks transformation, hidden knowledge, and intensity. Karmic theme: death and rebirth of the ego.
karakamsha_lagna_signs.sagittarius: KL in Sagittarius — soul seeks wisdom, teaching, and higher truth. Karmic theme: dharma and spiritual teaching.
karakamsha_lagna_signs.capricorn: KL in Capricorn — soul seeks disciplined achievement and authority. Karmic theme: karma yoga through worldly action.
karakamsha_lagna_signs.aquarius: KL in Aquarius — soul seeks innovation, humanitarian service, and group consciousness. Karmic theme: serving collective evolution.
karakamsha_lagna_signs.pisces: KL in Pisces — soul seeks liberation, spiritual dissolution, and divine love. Karmic theme: moksha and transcendence.

h1.theme: Soul nature, fundamental self at the deepest level
h1.ketu: Liberation-seeking soul. Primary purpose is moksha. Likely a highly evolved soul on final incarnation.
h1.jupiter: Dharmic soul. Born to teach, guide, and expand wisdom. Very auspicious.
h1.sun: Royal soul. Seeks authority and divine service.
h1.saturn: Karma-completing soul. Heavy responsibility but great eventual liberation.

h2.theme: Soul-level speech, family values, and wealth channel
h2.jupiter: Wealthy through dharmic means. Eloquent and wise speech. Family is dharmic.
h2.venus: Wealth through arts and beauty. Charming, pleasing speech.
h2.mercury: Wealth through intelligence and trade. Clever, quick speech.

h4.theme: Soul's relationship with mother, home, and emotional foundation
h4.moon: Very strong mother connection. Emotionally deep home life.
h4.jupiter: Dharmic home environment. Mother is spiritually elevated.
h4.ketu: Detached from home and mother. Spiritual home life or foreign residence.

h5.theme: Poorvapunya — past life merit, intelligence, children
h5.jupiter: Highest past life merit. Born with divine grace and wisdom. Excellent children.
h5.ketu: Spiritual past life karma. Previous ascetic or yogi. Detached from children.
h5.sun: Past life served authority. Intelligence is strong and authoritative.
h5.saturn: Past life karma through service and discipline. Few children, but disciplined.

h7.venus: Beautiful, artistic spouse. Love marriage. Harmonious partnership karma.
h7.jupiter: Dharmic, wise spouse. Marriage through dharmic channels.
h7.saturn: Karmic marriage. Older or disciplined spouse. Marriage serves karmic completion.
h7.ketu: Past life partner. Detached marriage or highly evolved spouse.

h9.theme: Soul's relationship with dharma and the divine
h9.jupiter: Born to teach dharma. Highest spiritual fortune. Father as guru.
h9.ketu: Moksha-oriented dharma. Previous ascetic. Guru in past life.
h9.sun: Solar worship. Dharma through authority and leadership.
h9.saturn: Dharma through karma yoga and austerity.

h12.theme: Moksha potential — spiritual liberation and transcendence
h12.ketu: Natural moksha karaka in moksha house. Liberation is primary soul purpose.
h12.jupiter: High moksha potential through wisdom and dharma.
h12.saturn: Liberation through karma yoga and service.
h12.venus: Liberation through bhakti — love and devotion to the divine.
h12.sun: Liberation through surrendering the ego to divine will.

special_combinations.ketu_in_h1_from_kl: Most powerful moksha indicator. Soul has completed most karma and seeks liberation.
special_combinations.jupiter_in_h9_from_kl: Dharmacharya — born to teach and guide. Greatest spiritual fortune.
special_combinations.saturn_in_h5_from_kl: Heavy past karma to process. Discipline brings liberation.
special_combinations.venus_in_h12_from_kl: Liberation through devotion and beauty. Bhakti yoga path.
special_combinations.sun_in_h10_from_kl: Born to hold authority and serve. Career is dharmic mission.
